sg.body: Qatar National Library brings together a national collection, a public library and a research library under one roof. Search across books, databases, events and services, in English or Arabic, from anywhere.

search.ask.body: You'll be able to ask in plain English or Arabic and get a short answer drawn only from QNL's own guides and collections, always with the sources shown. We won't show an invented answer here.
search.ask.try: For now, search the library or ask a librarian.
